app.title: Clarify - JSON file management system
tooltip.path: Enter the directory path or file path to search in
tooltip.browse: Open file browser to select a directory or file
tooltip.is_file: Check this if you want to process a single file instead of a directory
tooltip.extensions: Filter files by extensions. Examples:\n  .py,.js,.tsx\n  py,js,tsx
tooltip.sort_results: Sort file paths and results in alphabetical order
tooltip.include:
Advanced glob patterns to include specific files.
Examples:
  *.test.*    - Test files
  **/src/**   - Files in src folders
tooltip.exclude: Glob patterns to exclude folders/files.\nDefault excludes common build/dependency folders
tooltip.query: Enter the text pattern to search for in files\nResizable: drag bottom edge to adjust height
tooltip.whole_word: Match only complete words (not partial matches)
tooltip.regex: Treat query as a regular expression pattern
tooltip.multi_query: Enable multi-line query mode:\n- Line 1: main query\n- Lines 2+: OR alternatives
tooltip.search_button: Start search operation or cancel if already running
tooltip.replacement: Enter the replacement text (supports regex capture groups like $1, $2)\nResizable: drag bottom edge to adjust height
tooltip.preserve_case: Maintain the original case pattern when replacing
tooltip.replace_one: Replace only the first occurrence in each file
tooltip.replace_all: Replace all occurrences in all matching files
tooltip.logic_op: AND: All conditions must match\nOR: At least one condition must match
tooltip.add_condition: Add a new condition row (no maximum limit)
tooltip.save_results: Save all search results to a formatted text file with statistics
shortcuts.dialog.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.dialog.os_warning_message:
This shortcut may conflict with your operating system shortcuts.

Do you want to use it anyway?
tooltip.set_ops.file_a: First JSON file for comparison operations (intersection, union, difference) | Ctrl+O to open
tooltip.set_ops.btn_browse_a: Browse for first JSON file | Ctrl+O
tooltip.set_ops.file_b: Second JSON file for comparison operations | Ctrl+O to open
tooltip.set_ops.btn_browse_b: Browse for second JSON file | Ctrl+O
tooltip.set_ops.chk_multiple: Enable to add more files for sequential operations | Ctrl+Shift+S to open Set Operations
tooltip.set_ops.btn_add_file: Add more files to pipeline (operations applied sequentially left to right)
tooltip.set_ops.btn_remove_file: Remove selected file from pipeline | Del
tooltip.set_ops.btn_clear_files: Clear all files from pipeline | Ctrl+L
tooltip.set_ops.intersection: ∩ Intersection: Find items present in ALL files (A ∩ B ∩ C...) | F5 to execute
tooltip.set_ops.union: ∪ Union: Combine all unique items from ALL files (A ∪ B ∪ C...) | F5 to execute
tooltip.set_ops.difference: − Difference: Items in first file NOT in others (A - B - C...) | F5 to execute
tooltip.set_ops.symmetric: ⊕ Symmetric Difference: Items in A or B but NOT in both (A ⊕ B). Works with 2 files only. | F5 to execute
tooltip.set_ops.radio_key_value: Compare keys + values with strict type checking (e.g., 1 ≠ '1', true ≠ 'true')
tooltip.set_ops.radio_full_path: Compare full paths + values using dot notation (e.g., 'user.name' vs 'name')
tooltip.set_ops.radio_key_only: Compare only key paths, ignore values (useful for structure comparison)
tooltip.set_ops.skip_empty: Ignore null, empty strings (''), empty arrays ([]), and empty objects ({})
tooltip.set_ops.combo_output: JSON nested: single file with all results | Separate files: one file per operation | Display only: show in Results panel without saving
tooltip.set_ops.btn_execute: Execute selected set operations on provided JSON files | F5
tooltip.case.combo_source: Original case style of your code (auto-detect recommended) | Ctrl+Shift+C to open Case Converter
tooltip.case.combo_target: Desired case style for conversion (e.g., snake_case for Python) | F5 to convert
tooltip.case.ed_path: Path to file or directory containing code to convert (supports .js, .ts, .jsx, .tsx, .py) | Ctrl+O
tooltip.case.btn_browse: Browse for file or directory | Ctrl+O
tooltip.case.chk_is_file: Check if path is a file (unchecked for directory)
tooltip.case.ed_extensions: File extensions to process (comma-separated, e.g., .js,.ts,.py). Leave empty for all files.
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.ed_mapping: JSON or CSV file with key-value mappings (e.g., {"name": "John", "city": "NYC"}) | Enter to execute
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.btn_browse_: Browse for mapping file (JSON or CSV format) | Ctrl+O
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.ed_target: File or directory containing placeholders to replace (e.g., {t.name}, {t.city}) | Ctrl+O
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.btn_browse_: Browse for target file or directory | Ctrl+O
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.chk_is_file: Check if target is a single file (unchecked for directory batch processing)
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.chk_backup: Create .bak backup files before modifying originals (recommended for safety) | Enabled by default
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.ed_root_var: Root variable name for placeholders (default 't' makes {t.key}). Change for custom formats like {app.key}
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.ed_scope_st: Optional regex to mark scope start (e.g., <script> to only replace in JS blocks). Leave empty for entire file.
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.ed_scope_en: Optional regex to mark scope end (e.g., </script>). Must pair with scope start. Leave empty for entire file.
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.btn_preview: Preview replacements without modifying files (dry-run mode shows first 2000 chars) | F6
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.btn_replace: Execute replacements on target files (creates backups if enabled) | Enter or F5
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.btn_clear: Clear results panel and reset mapping cache | Ctrl+L
tooltip.placeholder_replacer.text_result: Displays replacement results: file count, placeholder count, and modified file list
tooltip.text_extractor.ed_input: HTML/JSX file or directory to extract text from (supports .html, .jsx, .tsx) | Ctrl+O
tooltip.text_extractor.btn_browse_input: Browse for input file or directory | Ctrl+O
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_is_file: Check if input is a single file (unchecked for directory batch processing)
tooltip.text_extractor.ed_output: Output JSON or TypeScript file path (e.g., translations.json or i18n.ts) | Ctrl+S
tooltip.text_extractor.btn_browse_output: Browse for output file location | Ctrl+S
tooltip.text_extractor.combo_mode: JSX Attributes: Extract label="text" | Tag Content: Extract <tag>text</tag> | Generic Scope: All quoted strings
tooltip.text_extractor.ed_param: Specific parameter/tag name to extract (e.g., 'label', 'title'). Leave empty for all parameters.
tooltip.text_extractor.combo_case: Key formatting style: snake_case (Python), camelCase (JS), PascalCase (Components), kebab-case (CSS)
tooltip.text_extractor.ed_limit: Max characters per value ('all' for no limit, or number like '50'). Smart truncation at word boundaries.
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_uppercase: Convert all extracted values to UPPERCASE (useful for constants)
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_avoid_cut: Truncate at word boundaries to avoid cutting words in half (e.g., 'Hello wo...' → 'Hello...')
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_drop_standard: Drop standard HTML tags (div, span, p, etc.) to focus on custom components
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_add_key: Include extracted key in hierarchical path (e.g., pages.home.TITLE instead of pages.home)
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_add_value: Include extracted value in path (e.g., pages.home.Welcome instead of pages.home)
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_nested_json: Generate nested JSON structure (e.g., {pages: {home: {title: '...'}}}) instead of flat dot-notation
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_ts_export: Add TypeScript 'export default' statement for ES6 module compatibility
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_only_strings: Extract only string literals (skip numbers, booleans, null)
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_exclude_numer: Skip purely numeric keys (e.g., '0', '123') to avoid array-like structures
tooltip.text_extractor.chk_skip_empty: Skip empty strings, null, [], {}, and whitespace-only values
tooltip.text_extractor.btn_extract: Extract text from HTML/JSX files and generate JSON output | Enter or F5
tooltip.text_extractor.text_results: Displays extraction results: files processed count, keys extracted count, and output file path
tooltip.file_list.ed_directory: Directory path to list files from (supports absolute and relative paths)
tooltip.file_list.btn_browse: Browse for directory to list | Ctrl+O
tooltip.file_list.btn_recent: Show recently accessed directories for quick selection
tooltip.file_list.chk_all: Show all files including hidden dotfiles (Unix ls -a option)
tooltip.file_list.chk_long: Show detailed file information: permissions, size, modified date (ls -l option)
tooltip.file_list.chk_human: Display file sizes in human-readable format: KB, MB, GB instead of bytes (ls -h option)
tooltip.file_list.chk_recursive: List subdirectories recursively, traversing entire directory tree (ls -R option)
tooltip.file_list.grp_advanced: Toggle advanced filtering options: regex, size, dates, extensions, depth, excludes
tooltip.file_list.ed_regex: Regular expression pattern for filename matching (e.g., ^test_.*\.py$ for test files)
tooltip.file_list.chk_regex_enabled: Enable regex pattern matching instead of simple substring search
tooltip.file_list.ed_size_min: Minimum file size filter (leave empty for no limit)
tooltip.file_list.cmb_size_min_unit: Unit for minimum size: Bytes, Kilobytes, Megabytes, or Gigabytes
tooltip.file_list.ed_size_max: Maximum file size filter (leave empty for no limit)
tooltip.file_list.cmb_size_max_unit: Unit for maximum size: Bytes, Kilobytes, Megabytes, or Gigabytes
tooltip.file_list.dte_mtime_after: Show only files modified after this date (inclusive)
tooltip.file_list.dte_mtime_before: Show only files modified before this date (inclusive)
tooltip.file_list.ed_extensions: Comma-separated file extensions to include (without dots, e.g., py,js,txt)
tooltip.file_list.spn_depth: Maximum directory recursion depth (0 = unlimited, 1 = current dir only)
tooltip.file_list.chk_exclude_node_modul: Exclude node_modules directories (common in JavaScript/Node.js projects)
tooltip.file_list.ed_exclude_custom: Custom exclude patterns (comma-separated, supports wildcards like *.tmp)
tooltip.file_list.cmb_presets: Select a saved filter preset for quick reuse
tooltip.file_list.btn_save_preset: Save current filter configuration as a new preset
tooltip.file_list.btn_load_preset: Load selected preset and apply filters
tooltip.file_list.btn_export_preset: Export preset to JSON file for sharing or backup
tooltip.file_list.ed_quick_filter: Quick filter: type to instantly search filenames in results table
tooltip.file_list.btn_list: Execute file listing with current options and filters | Enter or F5
tooltip.file_list.btn_export: Export current results table to CSV file | Ctrl+E
tooltip.file_list.table: File listing results: click headers to sort, right-click rows for context menu
tooltip.file_list.lbl_stats: Statistics summary: total files found, filtered count, and directory depth
